request.description: Flight casting loop in place: BOTH wings beat DOWN TOGETHER in a small controlled arc, return only to reference height. Phoenix extends neck, opens beak slightly with a tiny icy glow INSIDE beak, then recovers. Chest breathes, tail feathers undulate, rider remains seated. No blizzard, rings, external ice, sparks or beams. Exact approved rider and mount, same costume, colours, face and proportions, facing right, fixed camera. Preserve eyes with coloured iris and white highlight; no black empty eyes. Rider remains seated and hands retain reins or book. Far rider leg stays hidden; near wing stays in FRONT of lower rider hair/body consistently, below the face. Never move a wing across the face. No extra limbs, symbols, background, speed lines, exterior magic or particles. Return seamlessly to reference pose.
